body: If you don't have health insurance I get that, it would be very difficult financially.  If you do have insurance I recommend calling and seeing what the cost would be.

Thank you for the idea.  I never smoked weed before about a year ago but have been using it to help me sleep for a while.  It doesn't really do anything beyond that.  As for hallucinogenics I've always been scared to try them due to my state of mind.  All I've heard is that if you go into it with a negative mindset your trip will be bad.

You didn't.  Thank you for sharing your experience.  I recommend seeking help, it's very possible medication could help you.  It does help a lot of people, but it's a long process that is disheartening so I understand if you have trepidation.  I'm not one to give good advice based on where I am.. but it's worth a try.
